# Albert

> > Albert is an AI-powered personal financial assistant that helps users budget, save, invest, and protect their finances through integrated banking and wealth management tools.

Albert offers a comprehensive suite of financial products including budgeting tools, high-yield savings accounts, mobile banking with cash back rewards, robo-advisor investing, and credit protection services. The platform is built around Genius, an AI financial assistant that provides personalized recommendations and automates money management across all features.

## Key Topics

- AI-powered financial assistant
- Budgeting and spending tracking
- High-yield savings accounts
- Mobile banking and debit card
- Robo-advisor investing
- Credit monitoring and fraud protection
- FDIC insurance
- Auto-categorization
- Personal finance
- Money management
- Financial planning
- Identity theft protection
- Net worth tracking
- Bill management
- Early direct deposit

## Core Products

- [Albert | Your personal financial assistant](https://albert.com): Albert homepage: AI-powered personal financial assistant for budgeting, saving, investing, and shopping
- [Albert | Genius](https://albert.com/about/genius): Albert Genius: AI financial assistant for budgeting, money transfers, shopping, and personalized recommendations

## Banking & Savings

- [Albert Cash | Mobile banking. Cash back rewards.](https://albert.com/about/cash): Albert Cash: Mobile banking debit card with cash back rewards, early direct deposit, and 55k+ ATM access
- [Albert Savings | Earn on your savings.](https://albert.com/about/saving): Albert Savings: High-yield savings account earning 9x national average APY with FDIC insurance
- [Albert | Automatic savings](https://albert.com/about/smart-money): Albert Smart Money: Automatic savings, high-yield savings, custom goals, and FDIC-insured accounts

## Money Management

- [Albert | Budget and track spending](https://albert.com/about/budgeting): Albert budgeting feature: Track spending, monitor bills, and manage cash flow with auto-categorization

## Investing

- [Albert Investing | Buy stocks and ETFs](https://albert.com/about/investing): Albert Investing: Robo-advisor for stocks, ETFs, and managed strategies with $1 minimum investment

## Financial Protection

- [Albert Protect | Credit monitoring and financial protection](https://albert.com/about/financial-protection): Albert Protect: Credit monitoring, identity theft insurance, dark-web monitoring, and fraud protection
